# Brain Summary Report

This quarto is created to calculate the total number of genes with *regionally elevated expression* in the forebrain (i.e. the cerebral cortex, basal ganglia, thalamus and hypothalamus) in **human**, **pig** and **mouse**. \
Data obtained from the BRAIN SUMMARY table in the Human Protein Atlas (HPA) project. 


## Human
```{r}
human <- sum(180, 83, 57, 110)
print(human)
```

## Pig
```{r}
pig <- sum(109, 157, 31, 45)
print(pig)
```

## Mouse
```{r}
library(styler)
mouse <- sum(55, 185, 60, 98)
print(mouse)
```


The species that has the highest number of genes with regionally elevated expression is human, with 430 genes. 


**References**

[The Brain resource - Protein profiles of different regions of the brain](https://www.proteinatlas.org/humanproteome/brain)
